name: AR-A000002
summary: AR-A000002, also known as AZD-8129, is a drug which is one of the first compounds developed to act as a selective antagonist for the serotonin receptor 5-HT1B, with approximately 10x selectivity for 5-HT1B over the closely related 5-HT1D receptor. It has been shown to produce sustained increases in levels of serotonin in the brain, and has anxiolytic effects in animal studies.

pharmacology.text: AR-A000002, also known as AZD-8129, is a drug which is one of the first compounds developed to act as a selective antagonist for the serotonin receptor 5-HT1B, with approximately 10x selectivity for 5-HT1B over the closely related 5-HT1D receptor.

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study the 5-HT1B receptor, and was explored as a possible antidepressant and anti-anxiety drug. It never reached the market.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究 5-HT1B 受體的研究用化合物，也曾被探索作為抗憂鬱與抗焦慮藥物，但從未上市。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究 5-HT1B 受体的研究用化合物，也曾被探索作为抗忧郁与抗焦虑药物，但从未上市。

fact.en: It was one of the first compounds made to block the 5-HT1B serotonin receptor on its own, which let researchers study what that one receptor does.
fact.zh: 它是最早被製造出來、能單獨阻斷 5-HT1B 血清素受體的化合物之一，讓研究人員得以探討這個受體本身的功能。
fact.zhHans: 它是最早被制造出来、能单独阻断 5-HT1B 血清素受体的化合物之一，让研究人员得以探讨这个受体本身的功能。
